policy.attempt_boundary: new distinct proposal payload within a trial starts a new execution attempt
policy.run_config: all run_lock and normalized semantic run_config values must agree; resume_session/resume_checkout_path are provenance-only
policy.same_attempt_conflict: different payloads for the same tag hard-fail
policy.same_attempt_duplicate: identical payloads collapse logically but all observations remain in execution history

trial_attempts.selection_rule: latest_distinct_proposal_attempt; never mix downstream events across attempts
